set.body: Acceptance criteria: no internal constructor creates a zero-duration Event when public Event constructors reject it; inferred transitions that may have zero duration use an honest separate type or typed failure; EventSeries source-support evidence is derived from or validated against the exact recording range, event span, sample count, centre, and dispersion; EventSeries, SampleSupportLedger, SampleLabels, and AOI assignment expose total indexed access; tests kill zero-span, false-dispersion, bad-range, and out-of-bounds mutants.
set.title: Make event and support artifacts coherent and total
